annotation.title_clean: PL 177/2024 - Institui a Campanha de Conscientização e Prevenção contra Crimes Cibernéticos, cometidos por meio do uso indevido da inteligência artificial, contra crianças e adolescentes
annotation.title_en: Bill 177/2024 - Establishing an Awareness and Prevention Campaign against Cybercrimes Committed through Misuse of Artificial Intelligence against Children and Adolescents
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill establishing a national awareness and prevention campaign against cybercrimes committed through misuse of AI, especially deepfake child sexual content, targeting children and adolescents. It provides educational actions, civil society partnerships and budget funding, with no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Institutes a nationwide awareness campaign on AI-enabled cybercrimes against minors
Targets deepfake child sexual content and AI misuse
Educational actions via internet, radio, TV, posters in schools
Executive may partner with civil society and issue regulations
Costs covered by existing budget allocations
